content: sony/sonyflake README: Sony reassigned bits to 39 time (10ms units)/8 sequence/16 machine-id because Snowflake's 10 machine bits (1024 nodes) and 69-year lifetime were limiting 'on many host/core environment'; sequence only 256 IDs per 10ms per machine. Sonyflake validates StartTime < now at construction and returns an error when the time budget is exhausted - lifetime exhaustion is an explicit error, not silent sign-bit overflow. MachineID default = lower 16 bits of private IP, with CheckMachineID hook for uniqueness validation.
